messages:
Samir Patel: Quick heads-up — FinRegCo is asking if the POC can be EU-only for data residency. They want: subprocessors list for Frankfurt, confirmation that traffic won’t egress to APAC/US, and KMS key residency. Timeline: demo next Wed.

Mia Chen: @Samir we can do tenant pinning for a POC. Are they okay with a hosted POC (reserved capacity) or do they require Private (VPC)?

Samir Patel: Hosted preferred for speed, but they said "no cross-border egress" in the questionnaire. They also asked about subprocessors (managed infra, observability, SSO).

Jordan Lee: We support region preference routing for hosted — can pin requests to eu-central-1. Two caveats: 1) if capacity exhausted we currently failover to compatible EU variants only; 2) some infra telemetry (aggregated metrics) is processed in our control plane which today sits in us-west2 unless we enable EU control plane for the customer.

Ana Gomez: For the security questionnaire: we need to provide the subproc manifest + export controls note. Legal has an EU-only subproc list for customers who sign the EU-data addendum. @Mia do we have an easy export of that list?

Mia Chen: I have a copy but need legal sign-off. Quick workaround: we can provide the default list and flag any US-only subprocs. Example snippet I usually send:```text
- Compute: GCP (eu-central-1) / Partner: ManagedPoolX
- Storage: Redwood-managed S3-eu (encrypted)
- Observability: LogAggregatorEU (subproc)
- Auth: Okta (EU data residency option)
```

Evan Brooks: Cost/ops note — pinning to eu-central-1 + enabling EU control plane adds ~+12% infra premium for the POC. Also KMS-in-region (BYOK) integration has a one-off enablement task (~2 engineer-days) if they want customer-managed keys.

Samir Patel: Good to know. FinRegCo asked if BYOK is required for demo or just for production. They said they'd prefer BYOK ASAP.

Jordan Lee: BYOK path: we can accept a customer key in EU KMS and bind tenant keyring to that region. Need security review and KMS network peering for Private — for hosted we use envelope encryption but keys can be in EU if we enable EU control plane. Engineer estimate: 2 days infra + 1 day security review.

Ana Gomez: I'll queue the security review. Also confirm whether we need SCCs for transfers — legal to advise.

Mia Chen: Action items: 1) @Jordan confirm capacity SLA for pinned tenant in eu-central-1 for 1-week POC, 2) @Evan final POC cost delta, 3) @Ana pull signed subproc manifest / EU addendum template. Samir — I’ll draft the response to FinRegCo once we have these.

OpsBot: task created — deploy-request #472 for tenant-pin-eu POC (owner: Jordan Lee) :white_check_mark:

Jordan Lee: I can validate capacity today. If everyone OK I’ll provision a pinned pool and post ETA here (likely 48h).

Samir Patel: Perfect — thanks all. If we can get the subproc list and BYOK enablement estimate today I can send to the customer before EOD.
